title: 4 CD Lot Jazz: Pete Jolly, Phil Norman Tentet, Bill Watrous, Shelly Manne
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Discs and jewel cases show normal light wear consistent with age/storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Lot of 4 pre-owned straight-ahead and big band jazz CDs. Includes:

The Pete Jolly Trio - Yeah! (V.S.O.P. Records, 1996), with Chuck Berghofer and Nick Martinis
The Phil Norman Tentet - On The Town (Sea Breeze Jazz, 1997), with Bob Florence, Frank Capp, Carl Saunders and Bob Efford
Bill Watrous - Someplace Else (Soundwings, 1986), with Patrick Williams and his Orchestra, a live digital recording
Shelly Manne & His Men At The Black Hawk, Vol. 2 (Contemporary/Original Jazz Classics), the 1959 San Francisco club sessions with Joe Gordon, Richie Kamuca, Victor Feldman and Monty Budwig

All 4 CDs, jewel cases, and pictured inserts/artwork are included. Items are pre-owned and may show normal cosmetic wear from age and storage. Please review all photos carefully for exact condition and contents.

You will receive the exact CDs pictured.
